name: Moonshrine Sanctum
summary: Within Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight's Hammer gathers beneath Queen Azshara's statue. Twilight Lord Kelris watches over the ancient shrine, which guards the sealed way to Aku'mai's lair.

sections.title: A Desecrated Temple
sections.body: Past the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, cultists gather in the Moonshrine Sanctum, the heart of Twilight's Hammer activity inside Blackfathom Deeps. Night elves built the hall millennia ago to honor the moon and their rulers. Now the cult has defiled it, yet carefully maintains the towering statue of Queen Azshara. Beneath the cavernous stone ceiling, Twilight Lord Kelris watches as the cultists chant dark rituals day and night.

sections.title: The Threshold to Aku'mai
sections.body: The sanctum's heavy double stone doors seal Aku'mai's Lair behind ancient wards. Four ritual braziers stand around Azshara's statue; lighting them breaks the seal. The flames also rouse the shrine's guardians: giant crabs, snapped-jaw turtles, armored makrura, and conjured water elementals, all bound to defend the sanctum from intruders.

faq.answer: Moonshrine Sanctum lies deep inside Blackfathom Deeps, along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. Past the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, it stands just before the lair of Aku'mai the hydra.

faq.q: Who rules over the Moonshrine Sanctum?
faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris commands the sanctum. A formidable sorcerer who weaves sleep, he leads Twilight's Hammer rituals in honor of its ancient patron, touched by the void.

faq.q: Why is there an intact statue of Azshara here?
faq.answer: Night elves built the sanctum as an ancient temple dedicated to Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering. Twilight's Hammer keeps her statue in good condition and seems to have no quarrel with the queen it honors.

faq.q: How do you open the large doors at the back of the chamber?
faq.answer: Ignite the four ritual candles around the feet of Azshara's statue to open the doors to Aku'mai's Lair. Each flame awakens waves of guardian aquatic beasts and water elementals that must be subdued.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see an ancient temple carved by your ancestors before the Sundering, now turned into a sacrificial hollow for Twilight's Hammer and naga. Ashenvale's shadows reach even here.
As a priest, you hear Twilight Lord Kelris's twisted rituals turn sacred devotion toward maddening whispers of the void, far from restorative divine prayer.
